feeds.title: GoClimate Blog
feeds.description: Articles on climate change and global warming. GoClimate is a social company created in 2017 with the sole purpose of making it easier to start living a climate-neutral life, to slow down the biggest threat to humanity and the planet as a whole climate change.

feeds.title: Carbon Tax Center Blog
feeds.description: A leading source of hard news, rigorous analysis, and honest politics on taxing climate pollution efficiently and fairly for a clean energy future. The Carbon Tax Center ('CTC') was launched in January 2007 to give voice to Americans who believe that taxing emissions of carbon dioxide along with commensurate taxes on methane and other greenhouse gases is imperative to reduce global warming.

feeds.title: Carbon Credit Capital Blog
feeds.description: We support local and international clients by connecting them with high-quality emissions reduction projects, providing climate education, and developing innovative solutions that guarantee effective climate action. Get a better understanding of carbon, carbon neutrality, climate change and more!

feeds.title: Carbon Brief
feeds.description: We cover climate science and climate & energy policy, specialising in clear, data-driven articles to improve the understanding of climate change. Carbon Brief is a UK-based website covering the latest developments in climate science, climate policy and energy policy. We specialise in clear, data-driven articles and graphics to help improve the understanding of climate change, both in terms of the science and the policy response.

feeds.title: Carbon Literacy Blog
feeds.description: The Carbon Literacy Project offers everyone a day's worth of Carbon Literacy learning, covering - climate change, carbon footprints, how you can do your bit, and why it's relevant to you and your audience. The Carbon Literacy Project is globally unique - there is nothing else quite like it anywhere. It was recognised as such by the UN at COP21, in Paris, where it was awarded as a TAP100, one of 100 worldwide Transformative Action Programs.

feeds.title: Carbon Choices Blog
feeds.description: Carbon Choices is a monthly blog on climate and nature issues. It is focused on pragmatic solutions covering a wide range of topics including what you can do at home, our diets, travel, consumption, climate policy and thought pieces - from both the UK and international. This blog is published by Neil Kitching, an environmentalist from Scotland and author of Carbon Choices.

feeds.title: Carbon Drawdown Initiative Blog
feeds.description: Let us counter the climate crisis with something optimistic! Our basic idea is: let us not despair because nowadays everything is so awfully slow. Instead, let us make sure that the technologies and organizations will be ready when they finally will be put to use by the societies/governments of the world. Explore our blog for tips and advice to get our carbon footprint negative.

feeds.title: Carbon Credit Markets Blog
feeds.description: Expore our blog on Sustainability, Governance, Environment, Carbon Markets, Science, Curation and News Clippings.

feeds.title: Frank Dalene Blog
feeds.description: Frank Dalene is President and CEO of Telemark, Inc, a construction services business he co-founded with his brother Roy in 1978. Frank Dalene has brought Scandinavian values and quality to construction projects for the last four decades. Explore more of his articles on climate change, carbon imprint and more!

feeds.title: Soil Carbon Coalition
feeds.description: The Soil Carbon Coalition is a nonprofit organization working to advance the practice, and spread awareness of the opportunity, of turning atmospheric carbon into water-holding, fertility-enhancing soil organic matter and humus. We want to advance a different kind of science--based on shared evidence, open participation, specific locations and situations, and on learning to manage wholes consisting of people, land, the work of all species, and money.

feeds.title: Carbon Better
feeds.description: Find all the latests CarbonBetter posts about sustainability, the environment and carbon offsetting. We've spent over a decade serving clients as a trusted energy logistics partner, and we work with companies from all industries to measure, reduce and offset their footprint, and then certify their progress. We also help developers of carbon credit and clean energy projects and carbon removal technologies maximize their impact and ROI.

feeds.title: Carbon Credits News
feeds.description: The carbon credits market is set to become a driving force of the global economy for decades to come. It is the most exciting asset class of the future and carboncredits.com is your source for carbon news, carbon pricing, carbon opportunities, and more.

feeds.title: Post Carbon Institute Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2003, Post Carbon Institute's mission is to lead the transition to a more resilient, equitable, and sustainable world by providing individuals and communities with the resources needed to understand and respond to the interrelated ecological, economic, energy, and equity crises of the 21st century. Find insight and inspiration in a daily slate of articles about navigating a world with multiple emerging challenges.

feeds.title: Carbon Credit Cart Blog
feeds.description: Carbon Credit Cart is a simple way to balance carbon-generating home and work activities with verified carbon credits that fund real carbon mitigation projects. Learn more about carbon credits and how to save environment in our blog.

feeds.title: Carbon Lighthouse Association Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on CLA's impact, events, and climate news. The Carbon Lighthouse Association (CLA) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping companies and individuals offset their emissions by taking away some of the fossil fuel industry's ability to pollute.

feeds.title: Carbon Pricing Leadership Blog
feeds.description: The long-term vision of CPLC is to see that carbon pricing is implemented on a global scale and with rising ambition sufficient to help meet the Paris Agreement temperature goals. Browse opinion pieces from CPLC and partners on carbon pricing.

feeds.title: Carbon Collective Blog
feeds.description: Our research on the best ways to align your money & life with solving climate change. Carbon Collective is the first online investment advisor 100% focused on climate change. We help you invest your savings, whether they be for retirement or a more near-term goal like buying a house, into diversified, low-fee, climate-focused portfolios.

feeds.title: Element6 Composites Blog
feeds.description: Element6 Composites is an innovative engineering firm, specializing in the design, analysis, prototyping and manufacture of parts and products made from carbon fiber composites. Find everything you need to know about carbon fiber and composite manufacture.

feeds.title: ClimateTrade Blog
feeds.description: We aim to help companies achieve carbon neutrality by providing our innovative emissions offsetting services. Browse through our articles on carbon imprint, decarbonization initiative by various institutes, climate change and more!

feeds.title: TerGo Blog » Carbon Offsetting
feeds.description: Find exciting projects involved in carbon offsetting. Check on how individuals and businesses are benefiting from them. Read about carbon offsetting projects run worldwide. Be prepared to positively contribute to the environment by reducing and offsetting your carbon footprint. Our ambitious team and dedicated experts from all across the globe develop innovative tools that support sustainability for today's and future generations.

feeds.title: Carbon Neutral Cities
feeds.description: The Carbon Neutral Cities Alliance (CNCA) is a collaboration of leading global cities working to achieve carbon neutrality in the next 10-20 years - the most aggressive GHG reduction targets undertaken anywhere by any city. Get the latest news and updates on our work against climate change.

feeds.title: Carbon180
feeds.description: A new breed of climate-focused NGO working to build a world that removes more carbon than it emits. Get the latest carbon removal news, science, and original analysis from our team.

feeds.title: Teraapass Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog posts on Carbon Footprint, renewable energy, sustainability, and more. At TerraPass, we are a mission-driven environmental company that funds clean energy and greenhouse gas emission reduction projects.

feeds.title: DGB Blog
feeds.description: See the latest trends, tips, and inspiration in the world of environmental ecosystems about carbon neutrality and carbon offset from DutchGreen. DGB solves the very practical and real challenges of man's symbiosis and relationship with trees to harness free market forces and the access to capital needed to rapidly accelerate the reforestation of earth.

feeds.title: Grassroots Carbon
feeds.description: Grassroots Carbon helps leading companies remove and store massive amounts of carbon quickly, reliably, and naturally, so they are positioned to thrive in a carbon constrained world. Stay up to date on all things Grassroots Carbon.

feeds.title: CarbonCrop Blog
feeds.description: At CarbonCrop we use state-of-the-art technology to help landholders access carbon credits. We are helping people get paid for restoring biodiverse forests and scaling our climate change response using AI. Stay up to date on hoe we work, new forests we have come across and more!

feeds.title: Carbon Clean
feeds.description: View Carbon Clean's blog for the latest industry insights, and to find out more about carbon capture and storage. Carbon Clean is an established global leader in industrial carbon capture solutions helping essential, but hard-to-abate, industries decarbonize. Our innovative solutions significantly reduce the costs and environmental impacts of carbon capture compared to conventional technologies.

feeds.title: Ditch Carbon Blog
feeds.description: Ditch Carbon is the startup fighting climate change one decision at a time. We cover the latest on carbon footprints, climate change, our API and more!

feeds.title: Cambium Carbon News
feeds.description: Cambium Carbon is a people-centric, forward-focused company transforming the way communities and organizations approach the climate crisis. We believe in actions that drive results, and we are unapologetically committed to sharing the stories of our results with the world. Our stories are about impact and we believe impact inspires others to action. Get the latest news and updates on our work here.

feeds.title: Carbon News
feeds.description: Carbon News is New Zealand's only daily news service covering the carbon markets, climate change, sustainable business and the growth of the low-carbon economy. We've been publishing since 2008. It's the only truly comprehensive database of stories covering the establishment of the New Zealand Emissions Trading Scheme and climate policy in New Zealand.

feeds.title: CarbonChain Blog
feeds.description: The carbon accounting platform for commodity supply chains. Track your emissions and manage your transition to the net-zero economy. Discover the latest expert insights on carbon accounting, the commodities sector, and the net-zero transition.
